services.name: Interaction_UpdateCounter
behavior: Runs only when FRAME_PHASE_COUNTER is even and ACTOR_RESPONSE_COUNTER is nonzero.
Decrements the response counter and advances the decimal interaction counter.
Invokes the response reset helper after the configured 5000, 7500, or 10000 tick budget.

services.name: Interaction_UpdateResourceState
behavior: Runs the scene/resource decimal counter on even frame phases.
Triggers the matching resource command and optional audio event at the two resource milestones.
Arms the scene script countdown when the terminal resource state is reached.

services.name: Interaction_UpdateTarget
behavior: Moves the current interaction target value one step toward the target value.

conclusion: The gameplay interaction service has separate frame-gated response-counter, resource-milestone, and target-convergence helpers; the unthrottled counter variant at 0x001B00D6 remains a distinct reset-path helper.
